answer: Make the source record single-use. Before payout, an agent commits a Merkle root for its input files and reveals a nullifier per source record; the ledger rejects a spent nullifier across all keys, so copies of one observation cannot earn again. An onyx scan processed by a model kernel remains linked to its leaf in the provenance trellis. Proposed provenance fee: 0.04 POA per identity; 0.04 × 1,000 = 40 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.04 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: attackers can buy or fabricate genuinely distinct source data.
